terms.title: Terms and conditions
terms.notice: Draft terms of use for the informational version of TerraTech.
terms.body.1.title: Purpose and acceptance of the terms
terms.body.1.text: These terms describe the use of the TerraTech informational website, developed by NovaTech. When using it, you are expected to follow the rules stated here. Visiting the page does not constitute a purchase or create a payment obligation.
terms.body.2.title: Service description
terms.body.2.text: TerraTech presents a solution for managing plots and sensors, viewing soil moisture, temperature and nutrients, reviewing moisture history, the weather forecast and the satellite view, and accessing previously downloaded information. Screenshots show examples of the application. This page does not connect sensors or retrieve actual readings for visitors.
terms.body.3.title: Account registration and use
terms.body.3.text: The landing page does not provide account registration or sign-in. If you use the TerraTech application, you should provide accurate information, protect your credentials, and use only accounts, plots and devices you are authorized to access. Application-specific terms must be communicated before use.
terms.body.4.title: Content use and acceptable conduct
terms.body.4.text: You may view the content to learn about TerraTech and evaluate its features. You must not attempt unauthorized access to systems or third-party data, interfere with the website, introduce malicious content, or use the brand to impersonate the team responsible for the project.
terms.body.5.title: Intellectual property
terms.body.5.text: Text, designs, brands, photographs and other website resources belong to their respective owners or are used under their applicable licenses. Viewing the page does not transfer rights to these materials. Any reuse must respect applicable licenses and credits for third-party resources.
terms.body.6.title: Privacy and data processing
terms.body.6.text: This page does not request or collect personal data. Only the language preference is saved in your browser. The floating button opens WhatsApp, an external service with its own privacy policy, as is the case for the other external links.
terms.body.7.title: Limitation of liability
terms.body.7.text: TerraTech information provides support and does not replace assessment by an agronomy professional or guarantee production outcomes. Readings may vary depending on the sensor, installation and update date; downloaded data may be outdated. Check its freshness before making decisions. These terms do not restrict rights granted to users by applicable law.
terms.body.8.title: Changes to the terms
terms.body.8.text: The website content and these terms may be updated to reflect product changes. The last updated date will appear in this document. Published prices and plans are informational: this version does not process payments, activate subscriptions or confirm purchases.
terms.body.9.title: Contact
terms.body.9.text: You can message us on WhatsApp through the floating button on this page. You can also view the project report through the footer link to learn about the team and the context of TerraTech.
features.title: What you do with the app
how.title: Get started in three steps
how.description: TerraTech connects information from your sensors to an Android app.
how.step1Title: Create your account and your plot
how.step1Text: Sign up, fill in your land details and locate your plot on the map.
how.step2Text: Link the sensor to the plot with its code to start seeing its readings.
how.step3Text: Review each plot's indicators, history and weather, even offline.
faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: Do I need internet to use the app?
faq.a1: To update readings and to register or edit data, yes. Offline you can view the plots, sensors and readings you already downloaded, and the app shows when they were updated.
faq.a2: Soil moisture as a percentage, temperature in degrees Celsius, and nitrogen, phosphorus and potassium levels in ppm.
faq.q3: Which devices does it work on?
faq.a3: TerraTech works as an app for Android phones.
faq.a4: The Pro plan has a reference price of S/ 50 per month. For organizations, we discuss Enterprise plan options.
faq.a5: No. The information supports your decisions and does not replace assessment by an agronomy professional.
benefit.mapText: Locate your plot on the map and draw its outline; the app calculates its estimated area in hectares.
benefit.weatherText: Check the forecast for your plot alongside its readings and see when pausing irrigation is recommended.
benefit.satelliteText: See the satellite image of your plot with its vigor index (NDVI) and compare vegetation between two dates.
